Calm blue cruise-lighting fills the cockpit with steady, even light, instruments humming quietly beneath the pilot's hands.
A red-alert klaxon light pulses through the cockpit, washing the dash and the pilot's hands in stuttering crimson.
The warm amber glow of the instruments lights the dark cockpit softly, the only light but the stars beyond the glass.
The white flash of weapons fire outside strobes through the canopy, throwing hard shifting light across the interior.
A master-caution light pulses amber on the panel, its rhythm steady and insistent, demanding acknowledgment.
The soft rose-violet glow of a nebula bleeds through the canopy, tinting every surface in dreamlike pastel color.
A green all-clear washes across the dash, every indicator steady, the pilot's face lit in clean, even emerald.
A collision-warning strobe fires white and rapid, hammering the cockpit interior with brutal repeating flashes.
Only the faint blue ghost of the HUD illuminates the cockpit, everything else swallowed in near-absolute darkness.
The massive colored curve of a gas giant fills the canopy, flooding the cockpit in banded amber and ochre light.
Yellow caution lighting drops across the cockpit as a system fault registers, the panel alive with blinking indicators.
An emergency oxygen warning bathes the interior in pulsing blue-white, sharp and clinical against the dark controls.
The deep red of silent-running mode settles across the cockpit, dim and close, every display dimmed to minimum.
A targeting-lock indicator floods the panel in steady gold, the cockpit tight and bright with acquisition light.
Hull-breach alert strobes orange through the interior, fast and irregular, the pressure gauge needle swinging hard.
The pale silver-white of a nearby star bleeds through the canopy, overexposing the cockpit in cold, flat brilliance.
Shield-failure warning paints the cockpit in deep pulsing purple, each flash a reminder of naked exposure beyond the hull.
The engine-overheat alarm throws red-orange across the lower console, the cockpit filling with hot, urgent, warning color.
Navigation mode settles the cockpit in cool teal, soft and directional, the jump-coordinates glowing steady on the screen.
A proximity alert fires a fast yellow strobe, cutting the darkness in sharp bursts, the radar screaming close contact.
The pale green glow of a life-support nominal indicator holds the cockpit in dim, reassuring, steady emerald light.
Landing-mode lighting shifts the cockpit to soft white, instruments bright and clear, the runway grid filling the canopy.
Solar-flare warning floods the cockpit in blinding white-gold as the shielding glass auto-tints against the surge.
Docking clamps engage and a steady blue-white docking light pulses gently across the forward dash and pilot's visor.
Power-failure emergency lighting drops to a single dim red strip, the cockpit barely visible, controls dark and silent.
